item.title: Extreme cold and refreezing hampers road-clearing efforts across Central Virginia
item.description: Sub-freezing temperatures are limiting VDOT's ability to clear secondary roads in Richmond as refreezing undoes daytime progress.

item.title: Buddhist monks on Walk for Peace will pass through RVA. Here's their planned route.
item.description: A group of Buddhist monks on a 2,300-mile Walk for Peace are making their way toward Central Virginia, stopping in Brunswick County Wednesday night.

item.title: 14-year-old killed in Petersburg shooting dreamed of playing professional football, mom says
item.description: A Petersburg mother is remembering her 14-year-old son as a promising football player and honor roll student after he was shot and killed Friday evening at an apartment complex.
